name: Westminster
chain: MUTCD (latest edition; §8.21.02 still cites 'Part VI' — ghost citation preserved)
Model Traffic Code + CRS + Westminster Code of Ordinances

min_lane_width_ft.note: 'Minimum travel lane width in construction areas shall be ten feet (10 ft)' with proper controls incl. flagging; travel-way width may be restricted; on-street parking prohibition 'considered and noted'.

geometry.note: No taper/spacing tables — MUTCD latest edition is the design basis (§8.28.05: all necessary signing, striping, coning, barricading, flagging shown on the plan).

windows.note: Phrased as a closure-window rule: 'CITY streets shall not be closed overnight and work shall not force road or lane closures before 8:30 a.m. or after 3:30 p.m.' Weekday/weekend scope not stated in the source.

hours.override_note: Exceptions noted on the TCP + Traffic Engineer approval. Overnight complete/partial closures (removing 1+ travel lanes) need explicit Traffic Engineer approval (§8.28.07).

personnel.rule: 'Major projects shall require Traffic Control Plans prepared by a certified Traffic Control Supervisor' (§8.28.04(C)). The Traffic Engineer classifies plans minor/major.
Every TCP must name a 24-hour contact person responsible for TC devices, plus the firm responsible for traffic control.

tiers.label: Minor TCP
tiers.definition: Accepts 'a detailed MHT of the roadways and the proposed traffic control devices' OR 'a copy of a typical drawing of traffic device layout from an accepted source approved by the Traffic Engineer' — a jurisdiction that formally accepts third-party typicals for minor TCPs.

tiers.label: Major TCP
tiers.definition: Devices identified by type, 'explicitly noted and dimensioned' on drawings; prepared by a certified TCS.

notes.rule: Class D Public Way Contractor's License required and in good standing to apply for a ROW permit.
Colorado 811 confirmation number required on the application; if a City utility can't be located, a mandatory on-site meeting gates any excavation.
Insurance: $1M CGL/auto/employer-liability structure with blasting/underground riders when applicable; maintained through the maintenance period.

Field modifications may occur without revision to the plan provided the general intent is satisfied; City Inspector notified of substantial changes only (§8.28.08 — the most lenient field-modification rule in the corpus).
Copies of the approved TCP: 1 on site with the contractor, 1 with the City Inspector, 1 in the engineering file. Permit valid 9 months.

source.doc: Westminster Standards & Specifications Ch. 8 + Research-5 permit parameters

fees.note: TCP-review fee line items not located.

leads.label: TCP submittal
leads.note: TCP submitted earliest with final construction plans, latest with the ROW/public-improvement permit application; no permit without an approved TCP (§8.28.02).

leads.label: Signals projects — TCP to the Traffic Engineer

items.rule: Contractor keeps 1 approved TCP copy on site at all times.
